summary: Integrity Ironworks is a custom structural and miscellaneous steel fabricator at 33 Brookside Ave in Sayreville, NJ, operating since 1950 and fabricating carbon steel, stainless, galvanized, aluminum and hastelloy work (stairs, railings, platforms, catwalks, ladders, mezzanines). The shop runs an in-house team of estimators, detailers and welders, sells B2B to industrial/institutional clients, and takes work through phone (732-254-2200) and a generic customer-service email during weekday 7am-4pm hours. It is currently advertising for an Estimator/Project Manager while still using a downloadable PDF employment application, which points to manual estimating and hiring administration.

facts.fact: Fabricates custom metal work in carbon steel, stainless steel, galvanized steel, aluminum and hastelloy; positions itself as a New Jersey custom metal fabricator.
Company states a "tradition of quality and service since 1950" and "over 60 years" in business.
Organization is described as in-house estimators, detailers and experienced welders based in Sayreville, NJ.
Contact details: 33 Brookside Ave, Sayreville, NJ 08872; phone 732-254-2200; fax 732-254-0931; email customerservice@integrityironworksnj.com; hours Monday-Friday 7:00am-4:00pm.

Service list includes technical design and layout, estimating and budgeting, structural and misc. steel fabrication, stairways, railings, equipment access platforms, catwalks, industrial safety ladders, pipe and tube fabrication, rolled plates, grating and mezzanines.
Project page states Integrity Ironworks designed and fabricated a removable steel hoist to lift the FDNY Ladder 3 firetruck into the 9/11 Memorial Museum.
Same page names James Zagata as owner and President of Integrity Ironworks, Inc.

Open job posting for "Steel Fabrication Estimator/Project Manager" covering material take-offs, proposals, blueprint/spec review, time-cost-material-labor estimates, field measurements, estimate and material-order submission, and maintaining a supplier/contractor/subcontractor directory.
The posting describes the company as "a small, but growing, custom steel fabrication shop" and says salary is negotiable/commensurate with experience.

Careers intake is a 2-page downloadable "Employment application" PDF (applicant info, SSN, references, prior employment, military service, signature) with "OFFICE USE ONLY" start-date/rate fields; PDF metadata lists author Kaitlyn Dorn.
Home page shows three client testimonials attributed to a purchasing manager, a company president and a general manager, including one client stating 10+ years of working with the firm.
Site publishes an llms.txt advertising a Wix Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint so AI agents can query business details and site content.
Site is built on Wix (meta generator "Wix.com Website Builder", siteRevision 1277) and the XML sitemap's lastmod date for all pages is 2023-10-23; the footer reads "Copyright 2020".
The /careers path returns HTTP 404; the employment-opportunities page renders only the contact/hours footer block with no job listings shown.

operations_signals: Quote/contact intake is phone (732-254-2200), fax and a generic customerservice@ email; the contact page shows no web quote form, online booking or customer portal (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/contact).
Published hours are Monday-Friday 7:00am-4:00pm; no after-hours, weekend or emergency coverage is stated anywhere on the site (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/contact).
Single shop location at 33 Brookside Ave, Sayreville, NJ; the site markets to "New Jersey" broadly without publishing a service radius (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/contact).
Estimating is done in-house by staff estimators/detailers rather than through an online configurator or portal (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/about).

The estimator role requires field measurements of sites and assembling proposals, blueprints, specs and take-offs, i.e., quote turnaround depends on manual document review and site visits (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/project-manager-estimator).

Job applicants are funneled through a printable PDF application rather than an ATS, suggesting HR/hiring admin is handled manually in the office (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/_files/ugd/ff5782_0e28b44f78a6455ebc5366d08861a131.pdf).
hiring_signals: Currently advertising an Estimator/Project Manager: take-offs for structural and miscellaneous steel, proposal prep, cost/labor estimating, field measurements, submitting estimates and material orders, and maintaining a supplier/subcontractor directory (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/project-manager-estimator).

Job ad self-describes the shop as "small, but growing" and the hire as adding to an existing team, implying capacity strain in estimating/project management (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/project-manager-estimator).

No online application system or ATS: candidates download a two-page PDF employment application and the form still carries "OFFICE USE ONLY" fields for start date, probation completion and starting rate (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/_files/ugd/ff5782_0e28b44f78a6455ebc5366d08861a131.pdf).

No other open roles are visible: the employment-opportunities page lists no positions, and /careers returns 404; the only role page indexed in the sitemap is project-manager-estimator (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/pages-sitemap.xml).
review_themes: No independent review content could be retrieved: Google, Yelp, BBB, Indeed, LinkedIn and ZipRecruiter pages returned bot-protection/403 responses, and search providers were rate-limited throughout this session.

The only customer voice available is the company's own testimonial block, which praises reliability and craftsmanship, fast/creative problem solving, and long tenure (one purchasing manager cites 10+ years) - marketing testimonials, not third-party reviews (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/).
tech_footprint: Website is a Wix build (meta generator "Wix.com Website Builder", siteRevision 1277), i.e., no custom CMS or ERP front end (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/).

Site ships an llms.txt pointing AI agents at a Wix MCP endpoint with GetBusinessDetails/SearchInSite tools - unusually current AI-readiness for a small fabricator (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/llms.txt).
Content looks stale: sitemap lastmod is 2023-10-23 for every page and the footer still reads Copyright 2020 (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/pages-sitemap.xml).

Project/case-study pages (/911, /njchemicalplant, /hurricanesandy) carry their narrative in images only - text extraction returned no body copy, so the work history is not machine-readable or indexable (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/911).
Careers workflow uses a static PDF form rather than a Wix Forms/ATS integration (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/_files/ugd/ff5782_0e28b44f78a6455ebc5366d08861a131.pdf).

Generic role-based email (customerservice@) published alongside phone and fax; no chat widget, booking widget or client login appears in site navigation or contact content (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/contact).
growth_signals: High-profile institutional job: designed and fabricated a removable hoist so the 9/11 Memorial Museum could move the FDNY Ladder 3 apparatus inside intact (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/911).
Case-study pages for a New Jersey chemical plant project and Hurricane Sandy work indicate industrial/disaster-recovery project experience (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/njchemicalplant).
Capability list extends beyond fabrication into galvanizing, painting, erecting, burning, rolling and grinding, suggesting a broadened scope of supply (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/services).
Company describes itself as "small, but growing" and is adding an estimator/project manager, a growth-capacity signal (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/project-manager-estimator).

70+ year operating history (since 1950) supplies institutional longevity, though the site copyright (2020) and sitemap (2023) show no recent digital refresh (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/about).
decision_maker: James Zagata, Owner & President - listed on the company's own 9/11 project page (https://www.integrityironworksnj.com/911)

inferences.inference: Quote turnaround is likely a real bottleneck and a good first AI-agent target.
inferences.reasoning: Estimating is manual (blueprint take-offs, spec gathering, labor/material pricing, field measurements) and the firm is hiring specifically for that function while calling itself small but growing.

inferences.inference: Inbound demand may leak outside 7am-4pm weekdays.
inferences.reasoning: The only published intake channels are a phone number, fax and a generic email with no form, chat or after-hours message path; industrial buyers often scope work outside those hours.

inferences.inference: The customer base is B2B industrial/institutional rather than consumer.
inferences.reasoning: Projects referenced are a museum, a chemical plant and storm recovery, testimonials come from purchasing managers, presidents and GMs, and the catalog is heavy industrial (catwalks, equipment platforms, safety ladders).

inferences.inference: Hiring administration is manual and probably owned by one office person.
inferences.reasoning: Applications arrive as a printable PDF with 'office use only' fields and the PDF's author metadata is an individual name rather than a system, with no ATS visible.

inferences.inference: Their best proof points are effectively invisible to search and to AI assistants.
inferences.reasoning: Case studies are image-only with no extractable text, and the sitemap/copyright have not been updated since 2023/2020, so the 9/11 Museum and chemical plant work cannot be surfaced or cited automatically.

inferences.inference: An agent could convert project photos/history into draft case studies and RFQ responses with minimal oversight.
inferences.reasoning: The firm already curates project pages and a detailed services taxonomy; the missing piece is text generation and structuring, not source material.

data_gaps: No employee count, revenue or facility-size figures found; no source was reachable to estimate size beyond 'small' self-description.

No independent customer reviews retrieved: Google Business Profile, Yelp, BBB, Trustpilot and industry directories were blocked, JS-only, or had no Wayback snapshot; review themes are therefore unverified.
Job boards could not be checked: Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter and Glassdoor returned HTTP 403; only the company's own posting page is confirmed.

Search engines were unusable this session (web_search hit provider rate limits; Bing/DDG/Mojeek/Brave/Ecosia/Yahoo returned bot challenges or irrelevant results), so no news, awards, OSHA records or local-press coverage could be located.
Decision-maker title comes solely from the company's own project page; it could not be cross-verified against a state business filing or LinkedIn (both inaccessible).
Service radius, after-hours/emergency coverage, delivery fleet and whether they subcontract erection are not stated publicly.
Social media presence (Facebook/Instagram/LinkedIn) could not be confirmed; no profile was reachable or archived.
Whether the Estimator/Project Manager posting is currently open, and when it was posted, is unknown - the page carries no date.
